reviewed_callables.caller: ReprintDocumentHandler.HandleAsync entry at lines 27-31; endpoint POST /api/print-jobs/reprint-document in Program.cs lines 2066-2073.
reviewed_callables.callee: EF query over PrintJobs by CreateRequestId.
reviewed_callables.actual_behavior: Finds existing print job(s) for the same request ID and returns them as WasReplayed before validation or creating new jobs. If none exists, handler validates ShiftOpen/closed ShiftClose/Expense document, creates a marked reprint job and audit event, then SaveChanges; DbUpdateException triggers a second same-ID lookup.
reviewed_callables.inputs_outputs_side_effects: Same ID -> replay existing print job; new ID -> writes operational PrintJob and AuditEvent. No shift state or expense/treasury/accounting posting occurs. Endpoint comment at Program.cs 2066-2068 expressly says it never re-posts the document.
reviewed_callables.financial_relevance: FINANCIAL_PRESENTATION_AUDIT: makes a financial slip reproducible and records actor/reason/time. It persists audit/print metadata but not ledger movements.
reviewed_callables.counterevidence: Exact same RequestId is replayed; the reprinted copy receives a reprint identifier via composed-ticket path. This prevents the reprint action from being mistaken in software for a new source expense/close operation.
reviewed_callables.disposition: NO_ACCOUNTING_MUTATION; operational printing/audit rows are written by containing handler.
